description:
FILED s473t1 (Opus), found by the probes for task #1024's fix.  PRE-EXISTING
and independent of it (the -1 and 1.7 spellings never went through the
bareword path).  SILENT WRONG.

REPRO (scratch/s473t1/probe/kva-key.pl):

    our @a = (10,20,30);
    print join(',', %a[-1]),  "\n";   # perl: -1,30    PCL: 2,30
    print join(',', %a[1.7]), "\n";   # perl: 1.7,20   PCL: 1,20
    print join(',', %a["1"]), "\n";   # perl: 1,20     PCL: 1,20   (agree)
    print join(',', %a[zzz]), "\n";   # perl: zzz,10   PCL: 0,10

perl's `%a[EXPR]` yields (EXPR, $a[EXPR]) -- the key half is the index
expression's VALUE, unconverted.  cl/pcl-runtime.lisp's p-kv-aslice pushes
`(make-p-box i)` after truncating and wrapping:

    (let* ((i (truncate (to-number (svref flat j))))
           (i (if (< i 0) (max 0 (+ (length arr) i)) i)))
      (%p-vpush (make-p-box i) result)

FIX SHAPE: keep the ORIGINAL element for the key half and use the normalized
`i` only to reach the value.  One line; the reason it is filed rather than
fixed is that it is a runtime change with its own sweep (perl-tests/kvaslice.t
+ the companion op/ leg), outside this session's triage scope.

Pl/t/kvaslice-01.t's third s473t1 row deliberately asserts only the VALUE half
and cites this task, so the guard does not encode the bug.
subject: A kv-ARRAY slice reports the NORMALIZED integer as its key half; perl echoes the index EXPRESSION (`%a[-1]` keys -1, `%a[1.7]` keys 1.7)
